lens: Security — attack surface, OWASP, secrets, audit chain, supply chain
owasp_class_review: A06 Vulnerable/Outdated Components + A08 Software/Data Integrity considered. Net effect: A06 surface SHRINKS (two crates removed from workspace, zero new deps in Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock — only removals: -11 lock lines, -2 member entries). A08 considered because the lane being retired was a one-time integrity invariant (ARCHIVE rows under bominal/agents/ultragoal/archive/pre-grit-cutover-2026-05-12/ moved + originals absent + no living refs); replacement chain (M-CC-P11 Foundry pipeline admission + projected-merge-state + conflict kernel per ADR-0116) is the canonical integrity gate going forward, and ADR-0118 documents the substitution explicitly. A01 (broken access control) and A10 (SSRF) not in scope — no auth/route/network code touched. A02 (crypto), A03 (injection), A07 (auth) all N/A — kernel was filesystem-presence + ref-grep with no secret handling.
answer: Retirement is security-coherent. The archive-orphan kernel was a one-time cutover hygiene check (filesystem presence of ARCHIVE rows + absence of live refs to archived paths) — not a runtime security control. Its invariant (no living code references retired pre-grit-cutover paths) was time-bounded to the 2026-05-12 cutover and has fully landed. ADR-0118 cleanly justifies retirement, supersedes ADR-0052, and points the residual integrity invariant at M-CC-P11 (ADR-0116) as the canonical concurrent-work substrate. forbidden-operations.json FO-01 and FO-06 entries that used to cite archive-orphan-kernel are correctly amended: FO-01 now points to authoritative-tracked-kernel alone, FO-06 sets enforced_by:null with evidence pointing to ADR-0118/ADR-0116 replacement — this is an honest GAP acknowledgement, not a security carve-out. decision-principles.json DP-04 likewise drops archive-orphan-kernel from enforced_by, keeping authoritative-tracked-kernel. masterplan.json marks IP-008 retired with retired_by linking ADR-0118. Cargo.lock shows ONLY removals (no new dep introduced — supply-chain surface monotonically decreased). No secrets, no tenant data, no PII, no audit-chain emission required (the kernel itself never wrote audit events; it was a CI verdict). Catalog yamls deleted match crate deletion — no dead audit-chain pointers. The PR cross-references (IP-008, lane INDEX, .omc/fitness-lanes, evidence/agentic-pipeline/ip-008-archive-glue.json) are all updated coherently. Only LOW finding: a few stale on-disk uncommitted artifacts remain in the working tree of the current review branch (oya-m01-m02-gate-usecase-doc-drift is behind dev), but the merged tree at 59534679 is clean — this is a local branch-state observation, not a PR defect.
key_claims: Retired lane was a one-time cutover hygiene check, not a runtime security control — retirement does not weaken any access control, crypto, injection, or audit invariant.
Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock changes are removals only (-2 members, -11 lock lines); zero new dependencies introduced; supply-chain attack surface monotonically decreased.

forbidden-operations.json FO-01/FO-06 amendments drop archive-orphan-kernel references and either fall back to authoritative-tracked-kernel (FO-01) or honestly mark enforced_by:null with ADR-0118/ADR-0116 replacement pointer (FO-06) — no silent security carve-out.
decision-principles.json DP-04 keeps authoritative-tracked-kernel as the single enforcer — the doctrine the lane backstopped is still mechanically enforced.

ADR-0118 explicitly supersedes ADR-0052, lists three rejected alternatives (keep empty, rename, delete-history), and pins replacement to M-CC-P11 / ADR-0116 Foundry pipeline — clean audit-chain handoff.
Catalog yaml deletions (registry/catalog/oya-foundry-fitness-archive-orphan*.yaml) align 1:1 with crate deletions — no orphaned capability pointers in registry.
tools/oya-foundry-pr-review-dispatcher-app/Cargo.toml comment updated to remove archive-orphan from the enumerated lane list — no live code import of the deleted crate remains in the merged tree.
uncertainty_areas: Did any external CI workflow (GitHub Actions yaml outside the diff) still reference `cargo run -p oya-foundry-fitness-archive-orphan`? Diff does not include .github/workflows scan; should be confirmed by F11 observability or F4 ergonomic facet.

M-CC-P11 admission/projected-merge-state/conflict-kernel must actually be live before relying on it as the integrity replacement; ADR-0116 promotes it doctrinally but operational coverage is outside this PR's verifiable scope.
